environment_id.description: Reusable project environment id from automation_environments. Each run pins its active validated build. auto matches the repository, or the workspace default when no repository is set; none uses base tools.
environment_id.title: Environment Id

self_management.description: Owner-authorized changes this automation and its workers may make to its own instructions or existing schedules. Enable only when the owner requests this. Other definition fields remain fixed.

triggers.description: Every trigger must supply a stable id; do not generate different IDs on retries.
triggers.title: Triggers

HistoryMessage.description: A native or earlier-product public message. Slack-sourced rows add the source fields.
HistoryMessage.title: HistoryMessage

HistorySession.description: A native or earlier-product session row, as listed by history and product routes.
HistorySession.title: HistorySession

repo_url.description: Leave empty for general personal preferences across repositories. For repository-specific notes, use selected_repository_url or a confirmed repository_id from the current memory context. A mentioned name alone is not a confirmed identity.
repo_url.title: Repo Url

repository_id.description: Confirmed permanent ID from github_repositories; supports repository scope when the session picker is empty.
repository_id.title: Repository Id

ProductContinuationResult.description: The native conversation that continues an earlier-product session.
ProductContinuationResult.title: ProductContinuationResult

ProductFile.description: A published output, saved capture or workspace archive of an earlier-product session.
ProductFile.title: ProductFile

ProductFilePreview.description: JSON preview returned by the file content route when ``preview=true``.
ProductFilePreview.title: ProductFilePreview

SessionFilePreview.description: Metadata and bounded text of a native session file preview.
SessionFilePreview.title: SessionFilePreview

SourcedHistorySession.description: A /api/history row: stored IDs are kept; ``key`` is the source-qualified UI identity.
SourcedHistorySession.title: SourcedHistorySession
